explanation: The copy of stock was correct, but requests were fulfilled only when stock was strictly greater than qty, rejecting exactly sufficient stock. Non-positive quantities were not rejected, so negative qty could increase stock. Duplicate request_ids were only recorded after fulfillment, so a later retry of a previously seen unfulfilled id could be processed. The fix records each request_id on first encounter, requires qty > 0, and fulfills only when available stock is >= qty.
